slides.title: There is / there are
slides.subtitle: Para decir qué hay en un lugar
goals: Usar **there is** con singular e incontables, y **there are** con plural.
Combinarlo con **a, some, any** y números.

slides.title: Hay = there is / there are

head: Singular / incontable
Plural
rows: **There are** two banks. There are some apples.
**There isn't** a bank. There isn't any milk.
Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.

slides.tip: *How many…?* va con **are there**: *How many students **are there** in your class?*
